title: Build minimal Pong from the current static starter

prompts.everyday: I want to make a very basic and minimal pong game. white pales and white ball and black background. arrows control the right pale and w/s the left one.
prompts.precise: I want to make a very basic and minimal pong game. white pales and white ball and black background. arrows control the right pale and w/s the left one. Use one 640 by 360 canvas, white 10 by 64 paddles inset 20 pixels, a white 8 pixel ball moving at 240 pixels per second, and a black background. W/S move the left paddle; ArrowUp/ArrowDown move the right paddle. Play to 11; serve towards the player who lost the point. Replace the starter sample, fill the plan, and test the game.

replies: Towards the player who lost the point.
